precepts.text: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine, Ephraim is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver.
precepts.point: The inhabitant shall not say, I am sick; the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity. Psalms 103:1-4, bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits, who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases, who redeemeth thy life from destruction.
precepts.why:
Isaiah says, “For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.” The Lord is our judge, not the nations. And the Lord is our lawgiver. Brothers used to get confused over this, so David shows which tribe the lawgiver comes from: “Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver”.

You would think it is supposed to be Levi, the priestly tribe. It says Judah. Why? Because the Lord who is our lawgiver came out of Judah, as Hebrews 7:14 shows. Christ is the lawgiver: he is the one that gave Moses the laws, and he is from Judah.

precepts.text: Moab is my washpot; the Most High set them beneath Israel as a servant.
precepts.point: The wickedness of Moab against the children of God is real history the American Board of Education does not teach: enslaving us during the Tang Dynasty, feeding the ghettos, and building whole industries off our people. All of it will be manifested and answered for.
precepts.why:
Moab is exceeding proud, with his loftiness, his arrogancy, his pride and the haughtiness of his heart. David shows where the Most High set Moab: “Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.”

Moab is his washpot; the Most High set them beneath Israel as a servant. For all that pride, these Moabites will go back to their proper place and serve the nation of Israel for what they have done. The wickedness of Moab against the children of God is real history the American Board of Education does not teach: enslaving us during the Tang Dynasty, feeding the ghettos, and building whole industries off our people. All of it will be manifested and answered for.

points: David says the Most High has cast us off and scattered us, has been displeased, and asks Him to turn to us again.
